_: What kind of king you'd be, the first choice of a new chronicle (title.gd show_new; Crusader Kings 3's ruler designer, Total War's faction pick). Each type sets the starting King's two traits (characters.js TRAITS: what rulings weigh on him, royals.json stress.against) and his focus (royals.json focus.choices: which cards come more often, what weighs on him), and steps the reign's own choices up or down one place along their ladder (chronicles.js create, after the player's other choices): host (small, standard, strong: the royal host he is crowned with), trust (resentful, wary, loyal: the houses' faith in the crown), wealth (poor, comfortable, rich: his purse), petitions (rare, normal, often: lords at court each season). Card words: name, line (what kind of reign), gives (what it changes, in play). art: the painted still on its card (realm/assets).

warlord.name: Warlord
warlord.line: You rule from the saddle. The realm is held by the sword, and you mean to use it.
warlord.gives: A bigger host at your crowning, a thinner purse. Brave and quick to anger; paying for peace weighs on you.

peacemaker.name: Peacemaker
peacemaker.line: You'd rather the lords kneel than bleed. Justice first, the sword last.
peacemaker.gives: The houses trust you more, your host starts smaller. Just and honourable; cruelty weighs on you.

schemer.name: Schemer
schemer.line: A quiet word on the walls, a match made, a rival undone. You play the lords against each other.
schemer.gives: More lords come to court each season, and the houses trust you less. Cunning and ambitious.

builder.name: Builder
builder.line: Roads, markets, full granaries. You'll be remembered for what stands when you're gone.
builder.gives: A richer purse at your crowning, a smaller host. Patient and content; gold thrown away weighs on you.
